# TeamBlind Topics, Companies & Threads Scraper

TeamBlind (Blind) is an anonymous professional community where employees at Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Apple and thousands of other companies discuss layoffs, compensation, interviews and workplace life. This actor reads the public, signed-out pages and turns them into structured records: channel feeds, company discussions, keyword matches and full post threads.

No cookie, account, API key or proxy configuration is needed. The actor reads the same public HTML/JSON that a signed-out browser receives.

## Modes

| Mode | What it collects |
|---|---|
| `byTopic` | One or more channel feeds such as `tech`, `layoffs` or `software-engineering` |
| `byCompany` | A company's discussion list, starting with the full posts on its overview page and following older pages |
| `searchPosts` | Public post search for a keyword, sorted by relevance or recency |
| `byPost` | One or more post threads, including the comments TeamBlind shows to signed-out visitors |
| `byUrl` | Paste any supported TeamBlind URL; the actor detects post, channel, company or search |

## Filters and pagination

- **Sort** — `recent` (newest), `popular` / `top` (most engaged). Search supports `recent` and `top`.
- **Max records** — hard cap across posts, comments and errors (1–1,000).
- **Max pages** — listing pages followed per topic, company or search (1–100).
- **Comments** — turn the public comment tree into one record per comment, with `depth` and `parentCommentId`.
- **Company post details** — company overview pages already include full text; enable details to follow older company-page cards and fetch each post's body and engagement fields.

Pagination uses TeamBlind's own public "load more" action. When the site rotates its build, the actor rediscovers the action id and public key from the page's JavaScript, then retries.

## Record types

Each dataset row starts with `recordType`.

### `post`

- `id`, `alias`, `articleType`, `title`, `content`, `contentRaw`, `contentLength`
- `contentIsPreview` — true when the source only exposed a preview of the body
- `memberNickname`, `authorCompany`, `jobTitle`
- `boardName`, `boardId`, `channelId`, `channelSlug`, `channelName`, `channelUrl`
- `companySlug`, `companyUrl`, `companyLogoUrl`
- `createdAt` (relative label), `datePublished` / `writedAt` / `updatedAt` (ISO where available)
- `likeCount`, `commentCount`, `viewCount`, `lastCommentCount`
- `isPoll`, `isHot`, `isAuth`, `isHighlight`, `isHiddenCompany`, `isNow`, `isWormhole`, `isCompanyTagged`
- `tags`, `wasCompanies`, `mentionCompanies`, `images`
- `pollId`, `pollType`, `pollParticipantCount`
- `commentSummary` — TeamBlind's own thread summary, when present
- `url`, `sourceType` (`topic` / `company` / `search` / `post`), `scrapedAt`
- Mode context: `topic`, `company` or `query`

### `comment`

- `id`, `parentPostAlias`, `parentCommentId`, `content`, `memberNickname`, `authorCompany`
- `createdAt`, `writedAt`, `datePublished`
- `likeCount`, `replyCount`
- `isAuth`, `isOp`, `isCoOp`, `depth`, `images`
- `url`, `sourceType`, `scrapedAt`

### `error`

Emitted when a page cannot be fetched or no public records exist: `url`, `reason`, optional `httpStatus`, plus the requested mode context.

Empty fields are omitted at every depth. No `null`, `""`, `[]` or `{}` is written to the dataset.

## Examples

Browse the Tech channel, newest first:

```json
{"mode": "byTopic", "topics": ["tech"], "sortBy": "recent", "maxItems": 50}
```

Browse Google discussions, most popular, one page of extra posts:

```json
{"mode": "byCompany", "companies": ["Google"], "sortBy": "popular", "maxItems": 50, "maxPages": 2}
```

Search for layoffs stories:

```json
{"mode": "searchPosts", "query": "layoffs", "sortBy": "popular", "maxItems": 100, "maxPages": 3}
```

Fetch a thread and its public comments:

```json
{"mode": "byPost", "postUrls": ["https://www.teamblind.com/post/rumors-on-microsoft-layoffs-q8isdyxu"], "includeComments": true, "maxItems": 60}
```

Paste any mix of TeamBlind URLs:

```json
{"mode": "byUrl", "postUrls": ["https://www.teamblind.com/channels/layoffs", "https://www.teamblind.com/company/Meta", "https://www.teamblind.com/search/anthropic"]}
```

## Backward compatibility

Older tasks keep running. The input keys `mode`, `query`, `topic`, `companies`, `postUrls`, `sortBy`, `includeComments` and `maxItems` are all still honoured. `newest` is treated as `recent`; `topic: "Career"` is normalised to the current public channel. Retired keys (`cookieHeader`, `country`, `autoEscalateOnBlock`, `proxyGroups`) are accepted but ignored with a log line — cookies and proxy setup are no longer required, and only the English `www.teamblind.com` site is supported.

Existing output field names did not change. New fields sit beside them.

## Limitations

- Keyword search covers only what TeamBlind's public search exposes; login-only groups and private company channels are unavailable.
- A thread page shows a capped set of the most relevant public comments. `commentCount` is TeamBlind's displayed total and can be larger than the comments a signed-out visitor receives. The actor reports every comment the public page exposes and never fabricates the rest.
- Older company-page cards sometimes carry only the title and metadata. Turn on **Fetch full post details** to follow those cards for full text and engagement.
- The Korean site (`/kr/`, `kr.teamblind.com`) is a separate legacy application and is not supported.
- If TeamBlind blocks the actor's IP, it automatically retries through Apify Proxy. No user-side proxy setup is required.

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
pytest -q
apify run --purge --input-file input.json
```

## Input reference

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | (no default; prefill only) | `byTopic` / `byCompany` / `searchPosts` / `byPost` / `byUrl` |
| `topics` | array | (no default; prefill only) | Channel slugs or `/channels/...` URLs |
| `companies` | array | (no default; prefill only) | Company slugs |
| `query` | string | (no default; prefill only) | Search keyword (search mode) |
| `postUrls` | array | `[]` | Post aliases/URLs, or mixed URLs in URL mode |
| `sortBy` | string | `recent` | `recent` / `popular` / `top`; legacy `newest` accepted |
| `includeComments` | boolean | `true` | Emit public comments in thread mode |
| `includePostDetails` | boolean | `true` | Follow company-page cards for full post details |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Hard cap on emitted records (1–1000) |
| `maxPages` | integer | `5` | Listing pages per topic/company/search (1–100) |

Scheduled prefill: `mode=byTopic`, `topics=["tech"]`, `maxItems=3`, `maxPages=1`, comments/details off — the smallest run with output.
